description_html:

original_title: Women's Fashion Sandals Cross Border Pointed Thin Heel Sandals Shoes

US sizes 3–13
image_alt: Black croc-embossed faux leather mule with a pointed peep toe and a high stiletto heel, shown from the side
notes: Price is $86.22 (cost $30.56), far above the rest of this batch. The first photo shows black croc, but there is no 'Black Croc' color, only 'Black'. The second photo shows rose-gold metallic, which may be the 'Gold' option. The size table covers only EU 34-39, but sizes go up to 45. Supplier lists 8-15 days production time, which may lengthen delivery. Specs say the heel is above 8 cm, so the copy says 'high stiletto' with no inches.

US sizes 4–10
image_alt: Pair of metallic orange square-toe mules with a wide strap and a low flared block heel on a white background
notes: The title says 'gold', but the only color is orange and the photos show metallic orange. The photos look like retailer studio shots, with a brand logo visible on the heel caps, so check image rights before using them. There is no size table.

US sizes 3–11
image_alt: Feet wearing metallic copper-red peep-toe slip-on flats with a crinkled, leather-look finish
notes: Specs give no upper material, so the copy says only 'leather-look'. The supplier size table maps China sizes, which disagrees with standard EU sizes, so standard EU-to-US conversion was used. Price varies by variant ($46.24-$48.08). Specs say 'open heel', but the front-view photos cannot confirm it. Specs call the rose colors Light Pink/Dark Pink.

original_title: Woven sandals women's flat toe sandals
